name: DS Automobiles
verdict: A Stellantis N.V. brand; Stellantis' large shareholders include Etablissements Peugeot Frères and Bpifrance, but neither passes the record test. Nothing found.
note: French Stellantis marque; title partner of DS Penske in Formula E (2025/26) and of the France SailGP team. Rating note: none, proposed here for a maintainer. The ownership is sourced (ds-automobiles-stellantis-ownership, stellantis-nv-record: largest holders Etablissements Peugeot Frères 7.72% and Bpifrance Participations 6.64%). Neither chain reaches a state with a record: France has no record in this data (Bpifrance is a French state investment bank) and EPF is the Peugeot family. The company test is left as not met: a 2015 Georgia jury finding against Chrysler over a 2012 Jeep Grand Cherokee death is a product-liability verdict (Georgia Court of Appeals affirmed 2016), and HRW's 2024 'Asleep at the Wheel' report on Xinjiang forced labour covers GM, Toyota, VW, Tesla and BYD, not Stellantis.
